geometryRule: Four new authored Tactics sectors. Location, period and architectural vocabulary are pinned here; tactical grid, paths, palettes and ARCA objectives are gameplay adaptations, not official map reproductions.

sectors.period: Original game, Lighthouse Island on Hillys; no Anniversary Edition treasure-hunt additions
sectors.location: Lighthouse Island — grassy terrace, rocky stairs and lower wooden landing
sectors.sourceFacts: The 2003 island lighthouse is Jade and Pey'j's home. Water, island greenery and the lighthouse define the setting; the two-storey tactical crossing is authored for this engine.
sectors.geometry: A grass approach reaches two rock terraces by stairs. A wooden upper crossing passes above a lower landing, with two separately addressable recovery markers at the same XY. Deep water remains impassable.

sectors.period: Original Teensies in Trouble forest world; no Rayman 2 Fairy Glade or later game locale substituted
sectors.location: Teensies in Trouble — enchanted forest roots and broken upper route
sectors.sourceFacts: The original Rayman Legends manual locates Teensies in Trouble in a magical forest. The tree-root geometry and tactical control posts are new gameplay adaptations.
sectors.geometry: A sinuous root crossing joins high forest ledges over a low, slower ravine. Root slopes form the only legal ascent; the upper interruption cannot be crossed as an invisible floor.

sectors.period: Base-game VDNH Exhibition complex at Facility 3826, alternate 1955; no real contemporary Moscow museum plan or DLC geometry
sectors.location: VDNH Exhibition — stone gallery, service trench and low maintenance crossing
sectors.sourceFacts: The base game includes an exhibition complex with upper galleries, stairs and a basement. The technical trench, two tactical relays and their dimensions are authored here, not an official level plan.
sectors.geometry: Broad stone stairs lead onto the gallery. A service trench runs beneath it, while a second lower slab admits a human below but excludes a taller body. Gallery pillars block sight at their true support height.

sectors.period: Original film Rainforest District, before any sequel locations or theme-park reinterpretations
sectors.location: Rainforest District — canopy walkways, wet lower path and riverbank
sectors.sourceFacts: The original film features a dense rainforest district with very tall vegetation and elevated walkways. The new tactical route and extraction markers are adaptations; no sequel Marsh Market is used.
sectors.geometry: An upper boardwalk curves around trees above a muddy lower trail and a pool. Two real slopes reach the canopy exit; the lower exit stays accessible to large footprints without stepping into water.
